title: WorkspaceStatus
description: data of `kriya runs status --workspace PATH --json --kup-version 1`: an envelope around the existing recovery assessment; status and semantic exit codes preserved (P-25, P-27). Belongs to the selected workspace at observation time, never to a selected trace row (P-22).

status.description: The existing recovery assessment status, verbatim.

exit_code.description: The semantic exit code the non-KUP command would have returned.

WorkspaceDescribe.description: data of `workspace.describe` (GUI M5): the read-only facts Kriya reports about a folder the desktop host picked. Nothing here classifies the folder as greenfield or brownfield; absent facts are null (the host shows Not recorded), never inferred.

workspace.description: Kriya's canonical spelling of the folder (control-plane identity input).

identity.description: sha256 workspace identity Kriya records in run manifests.

head.description: Commit Git reports for HEAD; null when unborn or not a checkout root.

dirty.description: Tracked changes or untracked files per `git status`; null when Git did not report.

changed_entries.description: Upper bound on changed paths (a rename counts its source too), capped at 1000.

reason.description: Why a fact is missing, when Git said.
